title: Inside a wireless gaming mouse

prompt: Wireless gaming mouse: engineering anatomy and cinematic motion reveal. A fictional, technically plausible 125 x 65 x 40 mm lightweight esports mouse built from 100-150 individual parts in assemblies A-H (shell and ergonomics, optical click switches, scroll wheel and encoder, optical sensor, main PCB, 2.4 GHz wireless, Li-Po battery and power, base and PTFE feet), with an interactive anatomy page: rotate, zoom, explode slider, select parts, highlight assemblies, button click, wheel spin, optical tracking, wireless and power-flow toggles.
